iOS shortcuts × github actions × cursor cli

world_signals: developers debating whether AI writes brittle code or just exposes brittle habits
mathematicians asking what proof means when machines can verify anything
archivists weighing the future of shared culture in an age of infinite remix
stadium lights warming up for a comeback show after a rough week
polling booths opening across Germany on a decisive autumn Sunday
San Francisco shrouded in overcast fog, fourteen degrees before dawn

composer-2.5-fast.concept: Switch between three lanes of rolling Karl-the-Fog banks, catching brief sunbreaks while dodging cold drizzle that thickens the mist.
composer-2.5-fast.session_hook: Chain three sunbreaks to trigger a golden-minute warmth multiplier.
composer-2.5-fast.escalation: Fog density rises and sunbreak windows shrink each wave.

gpt-5.5-extra-high.concept: Tap theorem nodes in sequence before an automated prover beats you to the QED line; a missed beat collapses the proof into scribbled chaos.
gpt-5.5-extra-high.session_hook: Completing a proof ring flashes an elegant one-line summary.
gpt-5.5-extra-high.escalation: Prover speed doubles and false lemmas appear as red herrings.

claude-opus-4-8-thinking-max-fast.concept: Draw branching paths through a commons archive; each fork remixes a sample into something stranger before copyright thorns snap shut behind you.
claude-opus-4-8-thinking-max-fast.session_hook: Longer remix chains unlock weirder hybrid genres at the finish.
claude-opus-4-8-thinking-max-fast.escalation: Thorn walls grow faster and archive tiles shuffle mid-stroke.

gemini-3.1-pro.concept: Flick incoming agent task cards into deploy, buffer, or discard piles before sunrise; wrong sorts ship bugs to production.
gemini-3.1-pro.session_hook: A clean sunrise deploy triggers a satisfying merge animation.
gemini-3.1-pro.escalation: Card velocity increases and ambiguous tasks blur categories.
